record.paper_title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
record.original_question: Let z(N0) be a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal. Decide whether the situation called case 4 can ever occur, namely whether there exists such an ideal z(N0) for which the range M(I-2S_-|z) is closed and has infinite codimension.

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Find out whether case 4 is impossible.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $\mathbb{N}_0=\{0,1,2,\dots\}$ and let $\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ denote the space of bounded scalar sequences $x=(\xi_k)_{k\in\mathbb{N}_0}$. The backward shift $S_-:\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)\to\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ is defined by $(S_- x)_k=\xi_{k+1}$ for $k\in\mathbb{N}_0$.

A linear subspace $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)\subseteq\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$, equipped with a quasi-norm $\|\cdot\mid\mathfrak{z}\|$ under which it is complete, is called a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal if:
 (i) (monotonicity) whenever $x\in\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and $y\in\ell_\infty(\mathbb{N}_0)$ satisfy $|\eta_k|\le|\xi_k|$ for all $k$, then $y\in\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ with $\|y\mid\mathfrak{z}\|\le\|x\mid\mathfrak{z}\|$;
 (ii) (shift invariance) $S_-$ maps $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ into itself continuously, and likewise the forward shift $S_+$ (defined by $(S_+ x)_0=0$, $(S_+ x)_{k+1}=\xi_k$) maps $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ into itself continuously;
 (iii) $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ contains the canonical unit vectors.

Consider the bounded linear operator $I-2S_-$ acting on $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$, where $I$ is the identity. Let $M(I-2S_-\mid\mathfrak{z})$ denote the range of $I-2S_-$ in $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$.

Question. Does there exist a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ such that $M(I-2S_-\mid\mathfrak{z})$ is closed in $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and has infinite codimension? Equivalently, decide whether this situation (called "case 4") is impossible.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem ("Problem 2: Find out whether case 4 is impossible") in Pietsch's 2023 survey on traces on operator ideals over Banach spaces. Web searches surface the survey and related papers in Pietsch's series on shift operators and traces, but no subsequent publication appears to resolve the case-4 question for quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals.

status_evidence.title: Traces on Operator Ideals Defined over the Class of all Banach Spaces and Related Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey by Pietsch containing the open problem about whether case 4 (closed range with infinite codimension for I-2S_-) is impossible.
status_evidence.claim: Problem listed as an open problem in the survey.

status_evidence.title: The Spectrum of Shift Operators and the Existence of Traces
status_evidence.snippet: Pietsch studies the spectrum of shift operators on shift-monotone sequence ideals and links it to the existence of traces; the dichotomy/cases concerning the range of I-2S_- are part of this framework.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework but does not resolve case 4.
